rationale: The second half of the M60 line round. `callsite-lines-825` already pins the conventions for calls, mixes_in, implements, contains, instantiates, imports, declared_type references and selector uses, each with a named pre-fix shape to forbid — but four constructs have NO line pin anywhere, and each has at least one plausible alternative site a counting gate cannot tell apart from the right one. (1) `return_type`: the result TYPE's line, two below the `func produce() (` line, on a different list from a parameter's. (2) `instantiates`: a generic CALL instantiates the FUNCTION at the callee line while a composite literal instantiates the TYPE at the literal's line — two targets and two sites in one body, which is why one case cannot pin the label. (3) `identifier_usage`: the identifier's OWN line, here the first line of a wrapped return expression. (4) `go_channel_operation`: the send/receive STATEMENT's line, with send and receive as SEPARATE rows sharing a target, and a receive inside a package-scope literal sourced at `global` — the GOD9 site, reachable only because the literal is at file scope. The FORBID rows are the alternative sites: the `func produce() (` line, the wrapped argument list's opening line, the last line of the return expression, the `select` keyword, and the enclosing function for the file-scope receive. Without them a regression to the naive site would pass. Every line and value was read back from live emission with script/m14/tmp/god9-dump.ts, and the same constructs are asserted with source-embedded markers in script/m14/tmp/go-round7-line-conventions.ts, which needs no hand-counted line at all. A `references` row carrying the `go_instantiation` marker was in the first draft of this file and was REMOVED after F3 rejected it: a generic CALL emits an `instantiates` edge, not a `references` one, and the row had been written from the convention rather than from live emission. Every other row here was read back with script/m14/tmp/god9-dump.ts. A hand-written line expectation is worth exactly as much as the emission it was transcribed from, which is the reason the same constructs are also asserted by source-embedded markers in script/m14/tmp/go-round7-line-conventions.ts.
